provinces.name: Koshi
provinces.facts: Home to Mt. Everest, Kanchenjunga, Ilam tea gardens and Koshi Tappu Wildlife Reserve.

provinces.name: Madhesh
provinces.facts: Fertile Terai plains of Mithila art, Janaki Mandir, sugar mills and border trade.

provinces.name: Bagmati
provinces.facts: Heart of Nepal — Kathmandu Valley, Pashupatinath, Swayambhunath and Langtang Himal.

provinces.name: Gandaki
provinces.facts: Annapurna & Dhaulagiri ranges, Phewa Lake, Muktinath and the birthplace of Nepal's unifier.

provinces.name: Lumbini
provinces.facts: Sacred birthplace of Gautam Buddha, Tilaurakot, Bardiya National Park and Tharu culture.

provinces.name: Karnali
provinces.facts: Rara Lake, Shey Phoksundo, Jumla's famous apples and the origin of Nepali (Khas) language.

provinces.name: Sudurpashchim
provinces.facts: Khaptad plateau, Api & Saipal Himal, Ghodaghodi Lake and the wild Far-West.
